I can't save this. I don't have a tool for keeping notes, and nothing I could find lets me write to your notes folder. So I can't promise I'll remember 21 October as your Tansleigh Packaging cutoff the next time we talk.

Your message will stay in this direct message, so you can point me back to it later. If you want a lasting reminder, a note in your own files or a calendar entry would be more reliable. I haven't changed anything.
